integrity: Proof and executable finite checks are provided; simulations are not substitutes for asymptotic arguments.
scientific_limitations: Static singleton approvals, iid uniform party labels and integer multiples of voters for the horizon; no result for unequal party probabilities or overlapping/time-varying approvals. Classical occupancy lemmas are credited. Unindexed equivalent fairness-price derivations remain possible.
title: Gaussian, logarithmic and birthday-window laws for the temporal proportionality price
